pitchSummary.interpretation: All nulls retained. Exported span and primitive capture-cycle windows are distinct; the longer measurement window is not a change to the finite mechanics or primitive sound.

measurementNotes.pitch: Every clip retains both fixed .10 s and .25 s starts with .30 s windows. Loop clips report both the complete exported-span estimate and the original primitive capture-cycle estimate; the two low-soft loops retain all twelve .30 s windows at phases 0 through .55 s. A null is a detector refusal, not a measured pitch. In the audited low-soft loops, valid root-correlation peaks in some windows fall below the detector's .85-of-global-maximum gate because its short-lag endpoint is stronger. No window is moved or omitted to conceal this limitation. Independent spectral analysis is recorded separately in the repository's HOLD evidence.
measurementNotes.timing: inspectMillis includes probe copying and diagnostics in this JVM run. It is not a production latency benchmark and is not phone performance.
measurementNotes.finiteBudget: Seam and cycle difference compare separately conditioned consecutive cycles, before leveling. Eight-wrap montages are listening aids, not independent seam proof. The finite source work budget does not fund the repeated acoustic capture.
measurementNotes.listening: Native listening approval remains open; this generator measures and exports audio but does not hear it.
measurementNotes.loopExport: Model 3 exports a span of at least three genuinely conditioned captured cycles, longer than the generic classifier's 1.5 s loop threshold. Primitive capture timing and sound are retained; exportSpanSeconds is distinct from cycleSeconds.
